learning_outcomes.text: Students will get basic practical skills for work with fundamental concepts, methods and applications of differential and integral calculus of one-variable real functions.

syllabus_topics: Real Functions of a Single Real Variable.
Limit and Continuity of a Function.
Differential and Derivative of a Function.
Approximation of a Function by a Polynomial.
